item.title: Bucks beat Pelicans 139-118 for their 3rd straight victory and 6th in 7 games
item.description: Ryan Rollins made a career-high seven 3-pointers and scored 27 points to help the Milwaukee Bucks beat the New Orleans Pelicans 139-118 on Friday night for their third straight victory and sixth in seven games.

item.title: Anthony Edwards scores 40 points to help the T-wolves hand the Mavericks their 10th straight loss
item.description: Anthony Edwards returned to Minnesota with his All-Star Game MVP award and scored 40 points to help the Timberwolves hold off Dallas 122-111 in the 10th straight loss for the Mavericks.

item.title: No. 22 Miami (Ohio) remains lone unbeaten in Division I with 91-77 win over Bowling Green
item.description: Luke Skaljac scored a career-high 22 points, Eian Elmer had 21 and No. 22 Miami University remained the lone unbeaten team in Division I with a 91-77 victory over Bowling Green on Friday night.

item.title: Atlantic 10 showdown between No. 18 Saint Louis, VCU ends with shoving, benches clearing
item.description: A showdown for first place in the Atlantic 10 concluded with the benches clearing and multiple ejections in an 88-75 win by No. 18 Saint Louis against VCU.

item.title: High school roundup: Girls and boys basketball playoff results
item.description: A recap of Long Island high school playoff basketball games from Thursday and Friday.

item.title: New acquisition Jared McCain scores 21 as the Thunder beat the Nets 105-86
item.description: Jared McCain powered the short-handed Thunder to a 105-86 win over the Nets with a season-high 21 points.

item.title: Joe Scott is out as Air Force basketball coach. The school was investigating his treatment of cadets
item.description: Air Force has ended its run with basketball coach Joe Scott.

item.title: Spectator brawl mars Deer Park boys basketball playoff win over Smithtown East
item.description: "We're starting a full investigation and sorting through all the details of an unfortunate incident at the conclusion of our boys basketball game," Deer Park superintendent Jim Cummings said.

item.title: When in Rome: Budapest pizzeria offers time-travel twist with ancient Rome-inspired pie
item.description: A Budapest pizzeria is serving a limited pizza that uses only ingredients ancient Romans could have eaten.
